answer: Weight in this economy flows like a river from a summit set of long-established agents, and each trust edge carries only a fixed maximum flow per epoch. A new identity earns influence only up to the total capacity of the honest edges reaching it, so an attacker who splits into a thousand accounts behind two real connections gains no more than those two edges allow. To multiply power, the attacker must buy many independent connections and lock collateral on each, making fake nectar far costlier than honest participation.
